blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — An OceanJet fast craft bound for Ormoc City from Cebu City ran aground at sea following a fire on board. Passengers immediately put on life jackets as they awaited rescue. The incident occurred at around 10:30 a.m. on Sunday, November 22. Rescue operations were ongoing as of this posting. In a statement posted on its social media page at around noon, OceanJet management confirmed that “a fire incident occurred involving one of its vessels operating on the Cebu-Ormoc route.” “We wish to inform the public that the fire has been successfully extinguished.
